methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $10M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Drones & Autonomous (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 7 same-sector peers exist in Drones & Autonomous, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

private.name: Rainmaker
private.rationale: Same sector (Drones & Autonomous), same stage (Series A)

data.narrative:
MightyFly is a Series A autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The target company has raised $10M to date. The comparable universe consists of 8 private companies operating in the same sector, including Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro; no public comparables exist in this narrow space.

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the basis of the valuation. Using total raised ($10M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to the next funding round yields an implied valuation of $20M. The Peer-Median method was not applied due to insufficient narrow peer datapoints—while 7 same-sector companies exist, filtering by stage, proximity, and valuation tier produced fewer than the required 3 comparable observations, making sector-wide median comparisons uninformative.

The triangulated valuation range supported by this analysis is $17M to $23M, with a median of $20M. This range reflects reasonable variance around the stage-progression baseline. Key uncertainties limiting conviction include the absence of directly comparable same-stage transactions in the autonomous systems space and reliance on a single methodology. Additional data on recent Series A closings in adjacent autonomous verticals, or disclosure of MightyFly-specific metrics (burn rate, revenue traction, IP strength), would refine this estimate materially.
